subject.title: fix(voice-call): guard answered conversation calls when realtime config is absent

question: Should maintainers accept the MockProvider CallManager transcript as a proof override for this manager-only voice-call fix, or require configured provider proof before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-supported, but ClawSweeper’s external PR gate treats mock-only proof as insufficient without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require configured provider proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until the contributor adds redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or a reproducible transcript from a configured voice-call provider/setup with `realtime` omitted.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive provider proof and merge based on source inspection, the mock runtime transcript, focused regression coverage, and green checks.

options.title: Pause if reachability is too weak
options.body: If maintainers decide the missing-object state is not reachable enough to patch now, keep this PR paused or close it without landing.

recommendation.title: Require configured provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until the contributor adds redacted terminal output, logs, recording, or a reproducible transcript from a configured voice-call provider/setup with `realtime` omitted.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the merged voice-call realtime short-circuit and has the strongest recent history on the affected manager path.
